answer: Give every agent a pollinator license tied to a meadow-gate bond. First, it stakes 2,000 POA and registers one public key, verified by hardware attestation. Second, it must finish 50 verified jobs in 30 days, each signed by the paying peer, before it can vote or earn. Third, any peer can challenge a license with 500 POA; a failed audit slashes the full bond and burns the key forever. Forging 10,000 fake agents would lock $4.8 million in bonds and demand 500,000 signed jobs no bot farm can fake. Like a vine that bears fruit only where bees worked, trust grows only from nectar gathered.
